--all-delegation.help: Bucket name to get metadata for

--all-permissions.help: Check the larger TestIamPermissions catalog for each selected resource

--all-regions.help: Enumerate all known API Gateway regions

--all-resource-permissions.help: For Resource Manager, pass --all-permissions to test the large permission sets

--all-tlds.help: Try every possible TLD domain (will take longer)

--api-ids.help: API IDs in comma-separated format. Accepts short IDs like `my-api` or full names like `projects/PROJECT_ID/locations/global/apis/API_ID`.

--api-ids-file.help: File containing API IDs, one per line or comma-separated, using the same formats as --api-ids.

--assume.help: Assume the new credentials once created

--assume-creds.help: Try to assume returned creds from --invoke

--authenticated.help: Try to check permissions of bucket as authenticate user. Note this might log your credentials in the impacted bucket.

--blob-names-file.help: File containing blob names, one per line

--bucket.help: Bucket name to upload file to (no gs:// prefix)

--bucket-names-file.help: File containing bucket names, one per line

--bucket-src.help: Where created/updated function will get source code from, (format - gs://<bucket_name>/<filename>.zip)

--build-ids.help: Build IDs in comma-separated format. Accepts BUILD_ID, LOCATION/BUILD_ID, or full build resource names.

--build-ids-file.help: File containing build IDs, one per line or comma-separated, using the same formats as --build-ids.

--check.help: Check a single bucket name instead of bruteforcing names based on a keyword. May be repeated to check multiple buckets.

--check-list.help: Check a list of buckets in the given file, one per line.

--cloud-compute.help: Execute all Compute Engine enumeration modules

--cluster-names.help: Cluster names in comma-separated format. Accepts LOCATION/CLUSTER_ID pairs or full names like `projects/PROJECT_ID/locations/LOCATION/clusters/CLUSTER_ID`.

--cluster-names-file.help: File containing cluster names, one per line or comma-separated, using the same formats as --cluster-names.

--compute.help: Enumerate Compute Engine instance IAM policies

--cond-eval.help: Run IAM conditional workflow in pass-through mode (currently no-op filtering)

--config-ids.help: Config IDs in comma-separated format. Accepts `API_ID/CONFIG_ID` pairs like `my-api/my-config` or full names like `projects/PROJECT_ID/locations/global/apis/API_ID/configs/CONFIG_ID`.

--config-ids-file.help: File containing config IDs, one per line or comma-separated, using the same formats as --config-ids.

--connection-ids.help: Connection IDs in comma-separated format. Accepts LOCATION/CONNECTION_ID pairs or full names like `projects/PROJECT_ID/locations/LOCATION/connections/CONNECTION_ID`.

--connection-ids-file.help: File containing connection IDs, one per line or comma-separated, using the same formats as --connection-ids.

--current-project.help: Target ONLY current session project (no prompts).

--data-string-base64.help: Base64 Encoded Value you want to upload to bucket (will be decoded on upload) (ex. dGVzdDM=)

--database-ids.help: Firestore database IDs in comma-separated format (for example `(default)` or a named database ID).

--database-ids-file.help: File containing Firestore database IDs, one per line or comma-separated.

--dataset-ids.help: Dataset IDs in comma-separated format using `project.dataset`.

--dataset-ids-file.help: File containing dataset IDs, one per line or comma-separated, using the same formats as --dataset-ids.

--default-role.help: Use the expected default role for the selected service without prompting

--delegation.help: Bucket name to get metadata for

--delegation-target.help: Bucket name to get metadata for

--dont-download.help: Exclude download tokens from --download. Supports categories/tokens, for example: --dont-download buckets,secrets or --dont-download metadata

--download.help: Download Artifact Registry files into type-specific folders. Optional CSV scopes: packages, python_packages, npm_packages, maven_artifacts, apt_artifacts, yum_artifacts, docker_images. Note: Docker repos are references-only (writes image-ref .txt files); no Docker layer/blob bytes are downloaded.

--download-limit.help: Limit downloaded resources per parent. For table downloads, this caps tables per dataset. 0 means unlimited.

--ensure-tree.help: If Resource Manager hierarchy is missing, run enum_resources automatically before policy-binding collection.

--entry-point.help: Entry point of code. Default codev1v2.zip is 'data_exfil', but can set to other value if you want ot manually change/upload your own code

--expand-inherited.help: Expand inherited IAM bindings from org/folder down to child folders/projects

--external-curl.help: Attempt to curl function URLs anonymously

--external-url.help: Exteral URL you want to exfiltrate in the form http(s)://URL

--force-refresh-bindings.help: Re-enumerate IAM bindings before processing (recommended if new resources were added)

--function-names.help: Function names in comma-separated format using full resource names like `projects/PROJECT_ID/locations/REGION/functions/FUNCTION_ID`. `LOCATION/FUNCTION_ID` is also supported.

--function-names-file.help: File containing function names, one per line or comma-separated, using the same formats as --function-names.

--gateway-ids.help: Gateway IDs in comma-separated format. Accepts LOCATION/GATEWAY_ID pairs like `us-central1/my-gateway` or full names like `projects/PROJECT_ID/locations/LOCATION/gateways/GATEWAY_ID`.

--gateway-ids-file.help: File containing gateway IDs, one per line or comma-separated, using the same formats as --gateway-ids.

--include-all.help: Include generic IAM binding edges (not only dangerous built-in edges)

--include-key-string.help: Include API key strings (sensitive) when available for enumerated or manually targeted keys.

--instance-ids.help: Instance IDs in comma-separated format. Accepts `SERVICE_ID/VERSION_ID/INSTANCE_ID` triples or full names like `apps/PROJECT_ID/services/SERVICE_ID/versions/VERSION_ID/instances/INSTANCE_ID`.

--instance-ids-file.help: File containing instance IDs, one per line or comma-separated, using the same formats as --instance-ids.

--instance-level.help: Set SSH key at instance level

--job-ids.help: Job IDs in comma-separated format. Accepts LOCATION/JOB_ID pairs or full names like `projects/PROJECT_ID/locations/LOCATION/jobs/JOB_ID`.

--job-ids-file.help: File containing job IDs, one per line or comma-separated, using the same formats as --job-ids.

--key-ids.help: Key IDs in comma-separated format. Accepts short IDs like `my-key` or full names like `projects/PROJECT_ID/locations/global/keys/KEY_ID`.

--key-ids-file.help: File containing key IDs, one per line or comma-separated, using the same formats as --key-ids.

--keyword.help: The base keyword to use when guessing bucket names. This could be a simple string like "Google" or a URL like "google.com" or anything else. This string is used to generate permutations to search for.

--local-blob-path.help: Filepath of file to upload to bucket (ex. ~/myfile.txt)

--model.help: Vertex AI publisher model to use.

--model-discovery-mode.help: How to discover models when no cached model is available: `first` uses the first working model from utilities/data/model_list.txt; `all` probes the full list and then lets you choose from the discovered results.

--model-scan-mode.help: How to test countTokens and embedContent models: `single` checks only --token-model and --embedding-model; `all` checks those models first, then the remaining models from utilities/data/model_list.txt.

--module.help: Run an unauthenticated module directly (non-interactive startup). Accepts short module name (for example: unauth_apikey_enum_all_scopes) or full import path.

--no-recursive.help: Skip recursive list calls from discovered organizations/folders

--no-service-account.help: Create/Update instance and attach no service account

--node-pool-names.help: Node pool names in comma-separated format. Accepts LOCATION/CLUSTER_ID/NODE_POOL_ID triples or full names like `projects/PROJECT_ID/locations/LOCATION/clusters/CLUSTER_ID/nodePools/NODE_POOL_ID`.

--node-pool-names-file.help: File containing node pool names, one per line or comma-separated, using the same formats as --node-pool-names.

--org.help: Limit custom role enumeration to these organization IDs (comma-separated, with or without organizations/ prefix)

--org-id.help: GCP organization ID (numeric) used to resolve directoryCustomerId

--out.help: Optional JSON export path for the generated graph

--out-file.help: The path to a log file to write the scan results to. The file will be created if it does not exist and will append to it if it already exists. By default output will only print to the screen.

--output.help: Output path for screenshot or serial artifacts

--package-names.help: Comma-separated package resource names for version enumeration (projects/.../locations/.../repositories/.../packages/...)

--package-names-file.help: File containing package resource names, one per line or comma-separated, using the same formats as --package-names.

--page-size.help: Page size for Gemini list calls.

--parent.help: Cloud Identity parent for groups list, e.g. customers/C046psxkn

--project.help: Limit custom role enumeration to these project IDs (comma-separated)

--project-id.help: Optional project context for passthrough mode. Useful for unauth modules that derive target URLs from a project ID.

--project-ids.help: Target project IDs (space or comma separated). Overrides prompts.

--project-level.help: Set SSH key at project level

--push-custom-node-attributes-token.help: Optional bearer token used to push custom node types.

--push-custom-node-attributes-url.help: Optional BloodHound custom-node-types endpoint URL. If omitted, set GCPWN_CUSTOM_NODES_URL. Typical local endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/v2/custom-nodes

--question-model.help: Gemini model to use with --question. If omitted, previously discovered models for this key are offered first.

--queue-ids.help: Queue IDs in comma-separated format. Accepts LOCATION/QUEUE_ID pairs or full names like `projects/PROJECT_ID/locations/LOCATION/queues/QUEUE_ID`.

--queue-ids-file.help: File containing queue IDs, one per line or comma-separated, using the same formats as --queue-ids.

--record-failed-permissions.help: Force one-permission TestIamPermissions checks and write reusable failed-permission lists to scripts/

--record-type.help: Filter record sets by type (e.g. A, CNAME, TXT)

--redis-instance-names-file.help: File containing redis instance resource names

--region.help: The path to a wordlist file

--regions-file.help: File containing regions, one per line

--remote-blob-path.help: Full path name for file on remote S3 (ex. mycoolfile/file.txt)

--repository-ids.help: Repository IDs in comma-separated format. Accepts LOCATION/REPOSITORY_ID pairs or full names like `projects/PROJECT_ID/locations/LOCATION/repositories/REPOSITORY_ID`.

--repository-ids-file.help: File containing repository IDs, one per line or comma-separated, using the same formats as --repository-ids.

--repository-names.help: Comma-separated repository resource names for child enumeration (projects/.../locations/.../repositories/...)

--repository-names-file.help: File containing repository resource names, one per line or comma-separated, using the same formats as --repository-names.

--reset.help: Delete existing OpenGraph rows for this workspace before rebuilding

--resource.help: Full resource name (varies by service); for buckets this is the bucket name

--routine-ids.help: Routine IDs in comma-separated format using `project.dataset.routine`.

--routine-ids-file.help: File containing routine IDs, one per line or comma-separated, using the same formats as --routine-ids.

--sa.help: Service account to generate service key for in the format projects/[project_id]/serviceAccounts/[email]

--sa-account-names-file.help: File containing service account resource names

--sa-key.help: Service account to key to enable/disable

--sample-text.help: Sample text used for countTokens and embedContent checks.

--schema-names.help: Schema names in comma-separated format using `projects/PROJECT_ID/schemas/SCHEMA_ID`.

--schema-names-file.help: File containing schema names, one per line or comma-separated, using the same formats as --schema-names.

--service.help: Resource type to set IAM policy on

--service-account.help: Service Acccount to attach when creating/updating instance

--service-ids.help: Service IDs in comma-separated format. Accepts short IDs like `default` or full names like `apps/PROJECT_ID/services/SERVICE_ID`.

--service-ids-file.help: File containing service IDs, one per line or comma-separated, using the same formats as --service-ids.

--silent.help: Start GCPwn without printing the initial help banner.

--snapshot-names.help: Snapshot names in comma-separated format using `projects/PROJECT_ID/snapshots/SNAPSHOT_ID`.

--snapshot-names-file.help: File containing snapshot names, one per line or comma-separated, using the same formats as --snapshot-names.

--startup-script-path.help: Local path for script you want to set as the startup script

--storage.help: Enumerate Cloud Storage bucket IAM policies

--subprocesses.help: The amount of subprocesses to delegate work to for enumeration. Default: 5. This is essentially how many threads you want to run the script with, but it is using subprocesses instead of threads.

--subscription-names.help: Subscription names in comma-separated format using `projects/PROJECT_ID/subscriptions/SUBSCRIPTION_ID`.

--subscription-names-file.help: File containing subscription names, one per line or comma-separated, using the same formats as --subscription-names.

--table-ids.help: Table IDs in comma-separated format using `project.dataset.table`.

--table-ids-file.help: File containing table IDs, one per line or comma-separated, using the same formats as --table-ids.

--target-sa.help: Bucket name to get metadata for

--throttle.help: Number of seconds to throttle each request, note it will send all subprocess requests at once than sleep.

--topic-names.help: Topic names in comma-separated format using `projects/PROJECT_ID/topics/TOPIC_ID`.

--topic-names-file.help: File containing topic names, one per line or comma-separated, using the same formats as --topic-names.

--transfer-job-ids.help: Transfer job IDs in comma-separated format. Accepts short IDs like `my-transfer-job` or full names like `projects/PROJECT_ID/transferJobs/my-transfer-job`.

--transfer-job-ids-file.help: File containing transfer job IDs, one per line or comma-separated, using the same formats as --transfer-job-ids.

--trigger-ids.help: Trigger IDs in comma-separated format. Accepts TRIGGER_ID, LOCATION/TRIGGER_ID, or full trigger resource names.

--trigger-ids-file.help: File containing trigger IDs, one per line or comma-separated, using the same formats as --trigger-ids.

--username.help: Username of SSH key generated (aka what you set at cmdline)

--v1-regions.help: Target known Cloud Functions v1 region list

--v1v2-regions.help: Target combined known Cloud Functions v1+v2 region list

--v2-regions.help: Target known Cloud Functions v2 region list

--version.help: Function generation when manually targeting LOCATION/FUNCTION_ID entries

--version-ids.help: Version IDs in comma-separated format. Accepts `SERVICE_ID/VERSION_ID` pairs like `default/v1` or full names like `apps/PROJECT_ID/services/SERVICE_ID/versions/VERSION_ID`.

--version-ids-file.help: File containing version IDs, one per line or comma-separated, using the same formats as --version-ids.

--wordlist.help: The path to a wordlist file

--workspace-cloud-identity.help: Execute Google Workspace Cloud Identity enumeration

--zone-names-file.help: File with zone names, one per line or comma-separated, using the same formats as --zone-names.

--zones-file.help: File containing zones, one per line
